Third-party components inside the shipped Qt 6.10.3 libraries
=============================================================

Taken from the software bills of materials The Qt Company publishes with
Qt 6.10.3 (qtbase, qtdeclarative, qtsvg, qtimageformats, qtwebsockets),
limited to the modules and plugins Last Music Player ships. Licence texts
named "licenses/..." are in the licenses folder next to this file.
